headline: Anthropic's opus-5 hits all-time high; DeepSeek dominates provider share
summary: Claude Opus 5 just posted its best-ever token share at 5.5%, vaulting 5 spots in a single day—Anthropic's strongest showing in weeks. DeepSeek's provider share hit 26.6%, up 1.7 points overnight, while Google took a sharp 3.2-point hit. Three new models entered the top 51, and three others dropped out entirely.
highlights: Anthropic/claude-opus-5-20260723 sets all-time token-share record at 5.5%, jumps 5 ranks in one day
DeepSeek provider share surges to 26.6% (+1.7% in 24h), now commanding over a quarter of all tokens
Google provider share plummets 3.2 points to 6.8%—largest single-day drop on the board
OpenAI/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 climbs 2 ranks to #3 with 6.8% share, up 29 spots over 30 days
New entrants: Nex AGI/nex-n2-mini (#43), Qwen/qwen3.7-flash-20260727 (#48), Poolside/laguna-xs-2.1 (#51)
